title: Adult industry workers – income and work-related deductions

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Adult industry workers guide to income, allowances and claiming deductions for work-related expenses.

Income and allowance amounts you need to include in your tax return and amounts you don’t include.

Deductions you can and can't claim for expenses you incur to earn your income.

To claim a deduction, you need to get and keep records to prove you incurred the cost of the expenses.
